name: Com chay
summary: Crisp rice at the night market. Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu describes three pans: plain white rice, green from pandan leaf, and purple from magenta leaf, finished with scallion oil and pork floss. The paper printed 100,000 đồng for one tray at one stall. Other stalls were not priced.
origin: Chợ đêm Côn Đảo. Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, 16 May 2025.
howToEat: Buy a tray. The newspaper says most people take it away because seats are limited.
Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu printed 100,000 đồng for one tray at one stall. The market opens at 17:00.
where: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng, in front of the daily market.
priceBand: Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu printed 100,000 đồng for one tray at one stall. Other stalls were not priced.
seoTitle: Com chay — crisp rice in Con Dao
seoDescription: Cơm cháy at the Côn Đảo night market comes in white, pandan green, and magenta. One stall’s tray was 100,000 đồng. Other stalls were not priced.
